items.text: Bills ruled out WR DJ Moore due to shoulder injury (sustained in game, X-rays, stinger).
items.implication: Out for remainder of TNF; impacts Bills WR depth short-term.
items.opportunity: Other Bills WRs elevate if lingering.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs); unlikely available Sunday vs Raiders.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; consecutive DNPs.
items.implication: Expect inactive; boosts Johnston and depth WRs.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston primary beneficiary; Tre Harris deep-league.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday, second straight missed practice. If out, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore. Ja'Kobi Lane already IR/return with fractured wrist.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated Week 1; missed both practices.
items.implication: Growing concern for missing vs Saints; Bateman becomes primary flex.
items.opportunity: Target share opens for Bateman and others if OUT.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins injured hamstring at Wednesday practice; doctors don't believe serious but status for Sunday vs Bengals in jeopardy. DNP Thursday after limited Wednesday.
items.why: Hamstring injury in practice; history of multi-game absences on hammy.
items.implication: High risk of missing Week 2; monitor Friday/MRI.
items.opportunity: Routes last week 37/42 dropbacks; if out, Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel elevate.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson says 'I'm ready to go' after missing Week 1 (ankle). Unclear how much he earns vs Rhamondre Stevenson, but timing excellent: Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown IR, strong upcoming schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF/LV etc before bye).
items.why: Full practice return; explosive need post-Brown IR.
items.implication: Flex upside; monitor split with Stevenson.
items.opportunity: Role expansion possible in pass game and explosives; good matchups.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers DNP again Thursday due to last week's knee surgery; has yet to practice since.
items.implication: Likely miss Week 2 vs Chargers; Mayer fringe TE1.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 in Week 1 (tied Bijan for lead). 19% target share last 10 games; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4. Overreaction to injury scare.
items.why: Elite utilization despite ankle notes; full participant.
items.implication: Strong RB2/WR flex start vs LAC.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career) in Chiefs debut; 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q, 74% snaps, 40% route targets. RB1 overall range of outcomes if healthy. Indy just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage/target share in new offense.
items.implication: Start with confidence; massive season potential.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waivers: Ladd McConkey injury beneficiary Tre' Harris (among others like Bateman for Lane, Doubs for AJ Brown). Streaming and injury-beneficiary focused.
items.implication: Add Tre Harris/Johnston in impacted leagues.
items.opportunity: Immediate target upside if McConkey out.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow limited second consecutive day (back injury/tightness); expects to play but monitor.
items.implication: Likely plays but efficiency risk vs HOU.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: Career-high 26% target share Week 1, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB red-zone touches. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
Justin Jefferson LOVE: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; 93 yds/18 PPG career with Wentz. CHI allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: Volume with Wentz + soft secondary matchup.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE: Matched Miller rush attempts Week 1, 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role further; NO underdogs vs BAL not run-friendly.
items.why: Split backfield + Kamara return + poor script.
items.implication: Fade/sit; Miller beneficiary if Kamara limited.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid LOVE: 69% routes (highest last season), 77% snaps (highest since 2024 W9); efficient per-target. DET allowed 27 to Johnson/Fant.
